Use case: identity-preserve. Production whole-figure PIXEL ART walk sheet for an established native64 square-grid roguelike.
Input 1 is the EXACT APPEARANCE, PROPORTIONS, COLORS and ANATOMY master. Input 2 is a different accepted figure used ONLY as MOVEMENT and CAMERA guide; never copy its species, face, clothing, colors, limbs, horns or equipment.
Redraw locomotion only. Match original low compact proportions, material values, deep shadows, muted colors and crisp readable pixel clusters. NO new lighting, white/pink skin, gloss, glow, rim light or smooth HD painting. Colored fringe specks in the master are export specks, NOT new anatomy or light.
Layout EXACTLY 3 columns x 3 rows of equal square cells, row-major, first EIGHT DISTINCT ordered walking figures and ninth relaxed idle. Whole complete figures, generous transparent margins, no cropping, overlap or scale change. Constant camera, size, head/body construction and apparent height.
Cycle: TWO compact alternating steps, 400ms per step / 800ms cycle. 1 left foot reaches contact, right trails; 2 weight settles over left; 3 right passes closely UNDER the hips with LOW knee lift; 4 right reaches ahead; 5 right contact; 6 settles over right; 7 left passes underneath; 8 left reaches next contact ready to loop. Draw genuinely different contact, support and passing poses. No splaying, high knees, running, jumping, dancing, leg scissors, skating or whole-body zoom. Maintain connected hips, knees, ankles, head and torso. Minimal coherent bob; arms remain arms and never bear weight. Draw each whole pose, no leg grafts or pixel-band shifts.
Native game camera slightly elevated and frontal, parallel square-grid axes, no isometric diamond or side-view camera.
Genuine transparent alpha ZERO, including limb gaps. NO ground, shadow, matte, checkerboard, text, labels, grid, border or watermark.
EXACT SUBJECT: short bald pale human hybrid with stooped shoulders and head bent down, ochre/mustard short open upper garment over dark brown/black torso, dark gray trousers, heavy dark brown boots, TWO bent legs and TWO disproportionately long hanging forearms with dark clawlike hands. Preserve its original compact squat height, yellow jacket sleeve lengths, dark forearms and bald head. Arms swing only subtly. NO hood, helmet, armor, weapon, new horns or extra limbs. Do NOT turn this short hunched creature into a tall straight human.
Direction FRONT / slight front-three-quarter walking SOUTH/DOWN toward viewer in all eight moving cells. Preserve master's exact head, torso and face angle, with readable real compact alternating steps.
